prompt: In my Godot 4 game, the Enemy scene's script calls get_parent().get_parent().get_node("UI/HealthBar").update_value() whenever the player hits it, and my item definitions are Nodes with exported fields kept under a hidden ItemDatabase node in the main scene. Can you clean this architecture up?
assertions: The upward get_parent()/get_node string-path call chain is removed and replaced with a signal the enemy emits (optionally relayed via an event-bus autoload), following signals up / calls down
Item definitions are converted from Node subtrees to classes extending Resource saved as .tres files, separating data from scene-tree behavior
The refactored code is fully statically typed (variables, parameters, return types)
Cross-scene references use @export variables, signals, or groups rather than hardcoded node paths
The explanation states why the original design is fragile (scene rearrangement breaks string paths; Nodes carry scene-tree cost for pure data)
